llm_context.input_title: Validate matrix field formats in reusable-dispatch pre-computed matrix path
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Issue #6463 reports that inputs.matrix fields passed to reusable-dispatch.yml via the pre-computed matrix path are currently used without format validation, leaving downstream actions and env vars vulnerable to malicious or malformed input injection.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: While normal dispatch paths validate stage names and inputs using explicit regex patterns, the pre-computed matrix path lacks equivalent validation routines when parsing inputs from fromJSON().

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect ValidateWorkflowRef and HarnessRouter control flows
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect ValidateWorkflowRef in internal/mintcore/claims.go and HarnessRouter in internal/dispatch/router.go to understand how matrix inputs are currently accepted without format validation.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement regex validation for pre-computed matrix fields
step_by_step_plan.description: Add strict validation regex patterns for matrix fields (such as agent, role, and source_repo) in internal/mintcore/claims.go to reject malformed or potentially malicious input strings.

step_by_step_plan.title: Integrate matrix validation checks into HarnessRouter
step_by_step_plan.description: Update internal/dispatch/router.go to invoke the new matrix validation routines when parsing and processing pre-computed matrix inputs.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression tests and verify with test suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Add test cases in internal/mintcore/claims_test.go and internal/dispatch/router_test.go verifying that invalid matrix field formats are correctly rejected, then execute the test suite.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The process of checking untrusted input data against an expected format, type, or regex before using it in commands, file paths, or execution steps.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Without input validation, external or malformed parameters can manipulate workflow execution, inject malicious payloads, or cause cryptic runtime failures.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Directly relates to adding format validation checks on matrix fields like agent, role, and source_repo before they flow into checkout actions and env vars.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A coding practice where software is designed to anticipate and gracefully handle invalid, unexpected, or malicious states.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: It ensures that bugs and security vulnerabilities are caught early through clear validation errors rather than cascading into downstream failures.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue highlights that normal dispatch paths already enforce regex validation, and defensive checks need to be extended to the pre-computed matrix path.

common_pitfalls: Failing to validate all matrix fields (agent, role, source_repo, etc.) comprehensively.
Using overly permissive regular expressions that still allow special characters or injection vectors.
Not adding corresponding unit tests in claims_test.go or config_test.go for invalid matrix formats.
